hero.title: Premium Nitrogen Fertilizers
hero.desc: Powering global agriculture with high-purity Urea solutions. From source to soil, we ensure quality, consistency, and reliable delivery for your crop yields.

header.title: What is Urea 46% Nitrogen?
header.desc: The world's most concentrated solid nitrogen fertilizer, essential for healthy plant growth and maximum yield efficiency.

desc.desc: Our urea provides a high concentration of nitrogen in a form that is easy to handle and store. It promotes rapid vegetative growth and strengthens the root system.

1.title: Cost Effective
1.desc: Lowest cost per unit of nitrogen compared to other fertilizers.

2.title: Versatile Application
2.desc: Suitable for soil application, fertigation, and foliar sprays.

Forms.title: Product Forms
Forms.desc: Choose the physical structure that matches your application equipment and needs.

desc.desc: Smaller, smoother particles produced by spraying molten urea down a prilling tower. Ideal for industrial use and rapid soil integration.
Larger particles created through granulation. Superior hardness makes it resistant to crushing and dust formation during transport and blending.

header.title: Flexible Packaging Solutions
header.desc: Whether you are a local distributor or a large-scale agricultural cooperative, CalmaTierra adapts to your infrastructure. We manage the entire supply chain from production plant to your port of discharge.

reach.desc: Exporting to over 25 countries across South America, Africa, and Southeast Asia.

1.title: 50kg Polypropylene Bags
1.desc: Standard woven bags with PE liner. Easy manual handling for retail distribution.

2.title: 1,000kg Jumbo Bags (FIBC)
2.desc: Big Bags with discharge spout. Optimized for forklift handling and medium-scale storage.

3.title: Bulk Vessel Shipment
3.desc: Direct loose bulk loading into vessel holds. Highest efficiency for large volume orders (5,000MT+).
